offers_products.reason: Manufactures specialty coatings, sealants, flooring, admixtures and consumer paint brands like Rust-Oleum and DAP.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is overwhelmingly from manufactured products; roofing installation services are minor (Tremco) and incidental.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Consumer Group brands (Rust-Oleum, DAP, Zinsser) sold through retailers to DIY shoppers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Construction and performance coatings sold to contractors, distributors, industrial and commercial customers, and retailers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat orders of coatings, sealants and paints by distributors, contractors, retailers and maintenance customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand tied to construction, remodeling, housing and industrial activity, which can be postponed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Paints, sealants and coatings are small, frequent purchases, though roofing systems are larger.

people_delivered.reason: A manufacturer of coatings and building materials; customers pay for products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Buyers are many contractors, distributors, DIY households and retailers, not mainly large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Chemical blending plants need capital, but it's moderate; growth is largely through acquisitions and brands.

notes: Website text covers mainly Construction Products; consumer and performance coatings groups from general knowledge. Asset-heavy is a borderline call.
